name: Lane deviation

phase_0.boundary_condition: The physical lane markers and the vehicle steering rack limits

VINIT.justification: The unperturbed state where no lateral force or deviation exists.

TANCH.justification: The terminal constraint that defines the valid operational space.

AFWD.justification: The directed transformation of the vehicle position toward a boundary.

AREV.justification: The reverse morphism applied to negate lateral displacement.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of driver input to wheel angle to vehicle heading.

IMSCRIB.justification: The system's self-recognition of its own rotational state.

FSPLIT.justification: The split of a single steering command into left and right wheel forces.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of differential forces into a single vehicle trajectory.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative evaluation that the vehicle remains within markers.

EVALF.justification: The negative evaluation indicating a boundary breach.

ENGAGR.justification: A state where the vehicle occupies two lanes simultaneously without resolution.

IFIX.justification: The permanent irreversible record of the deviation event.

phase_3.void_description: Stationary vehicle with zero lateral potential
phase_3.true_description: Stable tracking within the designated lane
phase_3.both_description: Active correction during a boundary crossing

steps.domain_action: Initialize vehicle state at the lane center
Monitor current heading relative to the road geometry
Apply forward momentum along the longitudinal axis
Encounter a lateral gust splitting the force into vector components
Detect a deviation exceeding the safety threshold
Initiate counter-steering to oppose the lateral drift
Compose the correction through the steering rack
Reintegrate the opposing forces into a corrected path
Confirm the vehicle has returned to the lane center
Record the deviation and correction cycle to the telemetry log
Maintain the vehicle within the closed boundary of the road

phase_6.cycle_cost: Tire friction and electrical current in the EPS motor
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The cycle is a structural restoration of the initial state through lossless feedback.
